FINE WINE SALES

Stock locations:
- Our In Bond (IB) stock lies at London City Bond (LCB).
- Our Duty Paid (DP) stock lies at our Central London warehouse (available for immediate dispatch nationwide.)
Conditions of Sale
- All wines are sold in un-split cases unless otherwise specified.
- Duty & VAT is payable for all In Bond wines delivered Duty Paid.
- Allow 7-10 days for all In Bond orders to be delivered as Duty paid
- All wines are subject to availability & final confirmation.
Charges For Orders under £500
- In Bond LCB transfers or deliveries to 3rd party warehouses are charged at £16.50.
- Duty Paid deliveries to the UK mainland are charged at £16.50.
Condition Reports
- If you require photos/condition report: £14 plus VAT per line.
Ordering
